correctness.rationale: The frozen Finding, item 1, says that κ4<0 outside the open interval (a_−,a_+), which includes both endpoints. The explicitly verified identity κ4=−3P/D gives κ4=0 at each endpoint, not κ4<0. The proof otherwise yields the intended classification with negative sign only on 0<a<a_− and a>a_+. I reconstructed the stationary causal solution (exponential decay and bounded input) and the stationary moment systems. Ordered by velocity degree, the four positive block determinants are 4a²+4az+1, 8z, (4a²+12az+9)(4a²+12az+8z²+1), and 256z(3z²+1), so the exact variance and factorized cumulant from /tmp/opencode/scope-review-analytic.py 1 apply across the positive quadrant; no uploaded script was executed. P_aa>0 and P_z>0, with P_z≥12 on the closed rate half-line. Uniform coercivity on compact damping intervals ensures continuity of the minimum. The zero-damping polynomial gives a negative witness for sufficiently small positive z, and at z=1 the positive intercept and initial derivative imply a positive minimum. That minimum crosses exactly once, at an interior rate, yielding the intended two-root, double-root and no-root regimes. The checked threshold pair is (a_c,z_c)=(0.1096101765953479,0.0424392667442718) approximately. No repair is submitted because the corrected classification is itself fully covered by the distinct catalogue match.
residual_risks: No zero-damping stationary law is asserted; its polynomial is only a boundary witness. Threshold decimals are approximate.
